records.title: Gleichgewichtsdynamik nachweisen
records.aiReviewer: Independent chemistry reviewer A; inactive machine evidence only
records.aiNotes: A/B identities and joined AB are conserved in both displayed directions; species coexist and equal ongoing rates are stated. Distinct macro and model panels are legible at360/680. Constancy is an illustration, not an actual assay or proof that a real beaker is closed.

records.title: Spannungsreihen nutzen
records.aiReviewer: Independent chemistry reviewer A; inactive machine evidence only
records.aiNotes: Polarity, redox equation, salt-bridge arrows and printed table values are correct. The actual blue dimension annotation has an intermediate upward arrowhead immediately below SHE and its 1.10 V label in the lower SHE-to-Zn segment, plus a separate upper upward segment toward Cu. This makes the marked interval ambiguous and naturally assigns 1.10 V to SHE minus Zn, whose difference is0.76 V. A caption about schematic spacing does not fix the endpoints of a numerical interval. Use one unmistakable Cu-to-Zn bracket with only those two endpoints, or distinguish0.34/0.76 segments and label their sum1.10.

records.title: Primärzellen und Batterietypen fachlich beurteilen
records.aiReviewer: Independent chemistry reviewer A; inactive machine evidence only
records.aiNotes: Inner negative Zn and outer positive MnO2/carbon ring are correctly assigned. The bottom negative brass collector stops in zinc below the insulated upper seal; no conducting rod joins the positive button to zinc. Separator and lower insulating route distinguish conductors. This simplified topology agrees with the live manufacturer primary. Forms do not imply identical chemistries; open performance/cost/disposal criteria do not impose an unsupported ranking. Essential labels remain legible at360/680.
